blind.description: A stylized wooden pedal-powered grindstone or sharpening wheel. It features a thick, circular sandstone grinding wheel mounted on a dark iron axle with support collars. The wheel sits within a sturdy timber A-frame joined by square iron bolts and metal bracket reinforcements. Beneath the wheel rests a shallow blue-green water trough. On one side, a dark metal crank and connecting rod link down to a wooden foot treadle board resting on the floor. All surfaces are clean, solid, and stylized with hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: Seen directly from above, it shows the thick tan rim of the circular stone wheel centered over a rectangular frame with a visible teal basin inside, flanked by timber frame posts with iron bolt caps and an offset wooden foot treadle and metal linkage arm on one side.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 3 feet tall (roughly waist-high to the 5 ft 9 in figure), and about 2.5 to 3 feet wide/long across its timber base footprint.
